name: Sky-Splitting Portents
text:
When Sky-Splitting Portents enters the battlefield, scry 2.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put an omen counter on Sky-Splitting Portents.
Whenever you scry or cast a spell with mana value 6 or greater, put an omen counter on Sky-Splitting Portents.
When Sky-Splitting Portents has six or more omen counters on it, sacrifice it. When you do, create three 5/5 green and blue Elemental creature tokens with trample.
